answer: We define a mechanism wherein decentralized nodes, such as environmental sensors tracking a juniper stand on a knoll, post dynamic opportunity-cost staking collateral bound to zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions. Upon broadcasting a cryptographically signed telemetry pulse each epoch, any adversary attempting Sybil multiplication triggers a subgame-perfect slashing matrix that expropriates collateral for redundant identities. Consequently, expected attack utility is strictly negative, forcing convergence to a unique, Sybil-resistant Nash equilibrium.
